# RevKit.online

> RevKit (https://revkit.online) is a curated, open-access directory and comparison engine for reverse engineering tools, binary analysis utilities, decompilers, debuggers, and malware research environments.

## Core Categories

- [Disassemblers & Decompilers](https://revkit.online/category/disassemblers-decompilers/): Decompilers and disassemblers for x86, ARM, MIPS, and WebAssembly binaries (Ghidra, IDA Free, Binary Ninja, Cutter, Medusa).
- [Debuggers](https://revkit.online/category/debuggers/): Dynamic binary analysis, breakpoints, register inspection, and memory tracing (x64dbg, GDB, WinDbg, ScyllaHide, OllyDbg).
- [Android Reverse Engineering](https://revkit.online/category/android/): Dalvik bytecode analysis, APK extraction, dynamic instrumentation (JADX, APKTool, Frida, MobSF).
- [.NET Decompilers](https://revkit.online/category/dotnet/): C#/.NET managed assembly decompilers and deobfuscators (dnSpyEx, ILSpy, de4dot).
- [Binary Analysis Frameworks](https://revkit.online/category/binary-analysis-frameworks/): Symbolic execution, intermediate representation (IR), and concolic testing (Radare2, Angr, Capstone, Triton, Slither, Mythril).
- [Analysis Utilities](https://revkit.online/category/analysis-utilities/): Capability detection, memory inspection, file unpacking, and PE/ELF headers (capa, PE-sieve, Detect It Easy, UPX, 7-Zip, DWARF Explorer).
- [Firmware & Embedded](https://revkit.online/category/firmware-embedded/): IoT ROM extraction, emulation, and UEFI inspection (Binwalk, UEFITool, FirmAE).
- [Network Reverse Engineering](https://revkit.online/category/network/): Packet sniffing, protocol decoding, and API reverse engineering (Wireshark, Burp Suite, mitmproxy).
- [Distros & Environments](https://revkit.online/category/distros-environments/): Turnkey security operating systems and automated sandboxes (FLARE VM, REMnux, CAPE Sandbox, Volatility 3).
- [Java Bytecode](https://revkit.online/category/java/): Java decompiler utilities and class file inspectors (Bytecode Viewer, CFR, Procyon).
- [Game Reverse Engineering](https://revkit.online/category/game-re/): Runtime memory scanners and struct reconstruction (Cheat Engine, ReClass.NET).

## Essential Tools & Alternatives

- **Ghidra**: Open-source software reverse engineering suite developed by the NSA. Decompiles x86, ARM, MIPS to C. Best free alternative to IDA Pro. (https://revkit.online/tools/ghidra/)
- **x64dbg**: Open-source x64/x32 debugger for Windows malware analysis and software debugging. (https://revkit.online/tools/x64dbg/)
- **JADX**: DEX to Java decompiler with GUI and command-line interfaces for Android APKs. (https://revkit.online/tools/jadx/)
- **Wireshark**: World's foremost network protocol analyzer and packet sniffer. (https://revkit.online/tools/wireshark/)
- **capa**: Automated capability identification engine by Mandiant that tells you what an executable can do. (https://revkit.online/tools/capa/)
- **PE-sieve**: Scans running Windows processes to detect and dump in-memory malware, hooks, and shellcode. (https://revkit.online/tools/pe-sieve/)
- **Slither**: Static analysis and automated vulnerability scanner for Solidity and EVM smart contracts. (https://revkit.online/tools/slither/)
- **Volatility 3**: Advanced memory forensics framework for extracting artifacts from RAM captures. (https://revkit.online/tools/volatility-3/)
- **CAPE Sandbox**: Automated malware analysis sandbox with dynamic unpacking and config extraction. (https://revkit.online/tools/cape-sandbox/)
